parsed.change_summary: No changes were made to the code as the reported vulnerability (CWE-78: OS Command Injection) does not apply to the given code fragment. The 'pcre_exec' function is used for regex matching, not for executing OS commands. The 'subject' string, although attacker-controlled, is only used as input for the regex match and does not lead to OS command execution.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the 'pcre_exec' function is used strictly for regex matching and does not execute any OS commands. The 'subject' string, even if malicious, is only processed as part of the regex pattern matching and does not result in command injection.
